entities.summary: Vusal Abdullazade Azerbaijani karate athlete and sports figure. He is the Assistant to the President of the Azerbaijan Karate Federation, the official representative of the World Fudokan Karate Federation in Azerbaijan, an Honored Athlete of the Republic of Azerbaijan, a silver medalist at the European Championship, a winner of top-level international competitions, and holds a 5th Dan international black belt in the traditional Fudokan karate style.
